action_summary: Reuses the shipped lesson admission gate and SQLite skill store. A rejected reteach with executed BROKEN or REGRESSED evidence now invalidates the matching live rule, preserves prior admission history, and appends an admission refutation atomically. Evidence inputs are validated, snapshotted and deduplicated across held-out/archive roles; execution counts are recorded from actual baseline/candidate runs. Keeps concurrent main PR #6861 source-sensitive-oracle and pointwise-regression fixes. Adds no capability, flips no family, moves no benchmark, and claims no sentience.
expected_parent_change: canonical/swe_kernel/lesson_admission_gate_v1.py validates/snapshots/deduplicates evidence and records executed probe counts; canonical/swe_kernel/verified_skill_crystallizer_v1.py revokes refuted live rules and stores refutations atomically; canonical/tests/test_admission_refutation_and_evidence_v1.py adds 34 tests; the root report records the answer, measurements and limits.
falsification_condition: FALSIFIED if a rejected reteach with executed damage leaves the matching rule ACTIVE, if REFINE/REFUSED/no-damage revokes a rule, if duplicate/reordered/unreadable evidence is admitted, if counts include unexecuted probes, if scoped identity or bundle/reopen persistence fails, or if any focused regression fails.
explicit_user_authorization: PARAPHRASE, NOT A QUOTATION. The owner asked whether instant learning and arbitrary-environment computer use are already perfectly solved, demanded a truthful real-vs-false distinction including sentience, asked for the most advanced coding/general computer-use capability through real training/concepts/transfer/reasoning, required first-principles elimination of bad ideas and maximal current web/project search, and standing instruction to push and merge after work. This PR makes one bounded reliability repair and claims no universal mastery or sentience.
